title: Show stats
description: Show the stats column beside the drum: live keys per second with the attempt's peak, left/right hand balance, the last 24 hits by hand, alternation rate (share of consecutive hits on opposite hands; simultaneous big-note doubles are not counted) and same-hand repeats. Off leaves the drum and its four zone counts.

title: Drum size
description: Drum face diameter: small 116 px, medium 148 px, large 188 px. Small hides the DON labels inside the face.

title: Colour mode
description: How lit zones and the hit strip are coloured: by note type (centre don red, rim kat blue), by hand (left blue, right amber; also colours the hand balance bar), or a single neutral tone. In the hit strip don hits are solid and kat hits hollow in every mode.

title: Show 18—LAB tag
description: Show the small 18—LAB tag in the panel header.
